correctness.rationale: An n-point DFT applied separately to each ring decomposes the exact complex evaluation matrix into n explicit 2 by 2 blocks. The displayed trace and determinant follow by elementary multiplication; every determinant is the same angular factor times a positive block constant. The quadratic spectral formula proves simultaneous strict improvement of smallest/largest eigenvalues and determinant at the half-shift. Hardy weights give exact trace/determinant parameters; differentiation proves monotonic block ordering, and elementary limits establish the fixed-radius exponential and critical-window finite asymptotics. Direct Gram diagonalization reproduces the formula on 160 configurations (maximum absolute eigen error 5.78e-15); this numerical evidence supplements, never substitutes for, the exact proof.

value.rationale: Critical finite interpolation depends on the minimum singular value, determinant and condition number, which need not have a common optimum for general designs. A single weight-independent angular prescription simultaneously optimizes all three for every radial monomial RKHS and every radius pair, while the Hardy specialization quantifies a genuine qualitative transition from exponential instability at fixed interior radius to bounded conditioning at radial distance of order 1/n. The exact statement also identifies the only interpolation failure. This supplies a natural structural design rule and quantitative boundary law rather than a reparametrization of a fixed finite example.
